info.name: PropertyDealz.in API v2
info.description:
Complete API collection for PropertyDealz.in - Zero Brokerage Real Estate Platform

## Environments
- **Production**: https://propertydealz.in
- **Local**: http://localhost:8080

## Authentication
All authenticated endpoints use Bearer Token (JWT)

## User Roles
- USER: Regular buyers/sellers
- AGENT: Property agents  
- BROKER: Property brokers with subscription
- ADMIN: System administrators

## Quick Start
1. Run 'Login' request
2. Token is auto-saved to {{token}} variable
3. All other requests use the token automatically

1. Apply for featured (with/without coupon)
2. Create Razorpay order
3. Complete payment on frontend
4. Verify payment

item.name: 👁️ Property View Tracking
item.description:
Track buyer property views for notifications

**Business Logic:**
- Only tracks BUYER views (USER with 0 properties)
- Ignores SELLER, AGENT, BROKER, ADMIN views
- Notifications sent in batches every 5 minutes

request.description: Only tracks BUYER views. Ignored for: SELLER (has properties), AGENT, BROKER, ADMIN

item.name: 📤 File Upload
item.description:
File upload endpoints for images and documents

**S3 Structure:**
- /properties/{propertyId}/images/
- /properties/{propertyId}/documents/
- /properties/{propertyId}/deals/{dealId}/documents/
- /temp/ (for new properties)

**Limits:** Max 10MB

request.description: Upload to: properties/{propertyId}/images/
Upload to temp/ folder. Use when propertyId doesn't exist yet.
Allowed: PDF, DOC, DOCX
Upload agreement document. Sets agreementUploaded flag on deal.
Upload registration document. Sets registrationUploaded flag on deal.
